name: Party Identification 262 Choice
definition: Choice of formats for the identification of a party.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Identification of the party expressed as a BIC.

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to the party using a proprietary identification scheme.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Name and address of the party.

DigitalLedgerIdentification.name: Digital Ledger Identification
DigitalLedgerIdentification.definition: Place of settlement expressed with a Digital Ledger Identifier. It identifies a digital ledger or distributed ledger system (for example, blockchain or similar platforms).
